title.en: The Collapse of the Galactic Imperium

excerpt.zh:
随着[LastKilledCountryName]的毁灭，星海帝国瓦解了！

在这一片混乱的局势下，原有的星海共同体重获新生，以给星系带去一点恢复秩序的假象。
excerpt.en:
With the destruction of the [LastKilledCountryName], the Galactic Imperium has collapsed!

Amidst this chaos, the old Galactic Community has been reborn to bring some semblance of order to the galaxy.
